desc: The Caldwell Stable Table Lite is lightweight and durable, making it the perfect solution to overcrowded or rundown ranges. Setup and adjustments are fast and simple with a rotating seat and table depth adjustment to ensure maximum shooting comfort. No matter the weather or if the shooter is right handed or left handed, this table is ready for all situations with its ambidextrous seat pivots and all-weather tabletop and seat. Table is 23" x 34" x 32", seat height is 17". Ambidextrous, rotating seat, coupled with table depth adjustment, for maximum shooting comfort. All-weather tabletop and seat can support up to 250 pounds of weight. Table is fully collapsible, transports and stores easily, weighs less than 30 pounds.
